plan.english: "Mother, where is my father?" "Your father went to the field. Then he drove the cattle out." "When the sun sets, will he come home?" "He will come, and we shall eat together." "Mother, I am thirsty. Give me water!" "Drink, my son, and grow strong."

title: The Stranger Asks for a Wife

plan.english: "Guest, who are you, and whose son?" "I am a shepherd's son." "What do you seek in my household?" "I seek a wife, and I shall give a bride price of ten cattle." "Sit down, guest, and drink beer with us. Then I shall speak."
"Brother, wake up! Dawn has become bright." "Do not wake me, brother. I have become tired." "Let us go to the field, we two, and drive the cattle." "Go, then, and I shall come."
"Son-in-law, you have arrived! Enter my household. Sit and eat." "Father-in-law, I am bringing wine." "Wine is dear to a guest. Let us drink, and let us be joyful."

"Daughter-in-law, come. I am your husband's mother." "I am afraid." "Do not be afraid, daughter-in-law. This household is for you, and I shall protect you." "I have heard your words, mother, and I have become glad."
"Sister, where were you? I was seeking you." "I was at the river. Then I saw a wolf." "Are you afraid?" "I am not afraid. The wolf fled." "Come, sister, let us two go home. Mother will be glad."

title: Father and Son at the Plough

plan.english: "Son, yoke the cattle and carry the plough." "How shall I plough?" "Plough the field, my son, and the field will nourish us." "Father, I am working. Look at the field!" "Good is your work."
"Brother-in-law, guard my sister. If you deceive her, I shall kill you." "I shall love her. She is my heart." "I have heard you, son-in-law. Be dear to us."

"Son, whom do you love?" "I love that one, who dwells at the river." "Does she love you?" "I do not know." "Then seek her, son, and speak." "I shall speak, and she will hear." "May the god give you a good wife."
"I give ten cattle and a hundred sheep." "This bride price is great. I take it, and I give you this woman. Let the gods hear our pledge."
"Father, the guests are coming." "Let us give them wine and beer." "The cook is cooking." "It is getting dark. Let the fire burn." "Sit, mother, and drink wine with me."

"Mother, the night is coming, and I tremble." "Do not be afraid, my son. The dog guards the household, and the fire burns. Lie down and hear my song." "I am listening." "Dawn will become bright, and you will see the sun."
"Wife, do you love me?" "I love you. You are my husband." "My heart, I love you. May our name be famous, and may we have two sons." "May we two live."

"Father, who is Mother Earth?" "The Earth is the mother of mortals. She nourishes them, and Father Sky is their father." "Does the sky hear us?" "He hears and sees." "I shall speak to him." "Speak, my son, and he will hear."
In the father's household a son was born. The mother became glad. Then the father set a name for the son. May this name be famous, and may the son have imperishable fame. May he grow up.

"My son, if a guest comes to your household, seat him, and give him water and beer. Do not deceive a guest. A guest is dear to the gods." "I hear you, father, and I remember." "You will be a good man."

title: The Two Sisters by the Fire

plan.english: The two sisters sat at the fire. "Sister, I am afraid." "Do not be afraid, sister. Mother is near, and the fire burns. Let us two lie down." Then the two sisters lay down.
"Where are our two sons?" "They went to the river and drove the cattle. When the sun sets, they will come." "Do not be afraid. The wolf does not come to the household, and the dog guards the cattle."

The mother was sitting by the path, and she was looking. "Will my son come?" The sun set. Night was coming. Then she saw a man on the path. She ran forward. "My son, you have arrived!" And she became glad.

Two brothers drove the cattle. Then the two saw a wolf. The wolf crept toward them. "Brother, guard the cattle!" The two killed the wolf and became joyful. They ran home. The father said: "Great is your fame, sons."
Dawn became bright. Then the mother milked the sheep, and the father drove the cattle out. The son ploughed the field. The sister carried beer. The sun became bright.
"Sons, hear my words. I remember. I saw your mother at the river. Then I loved her. I gave ten cattle for her. Her father gave her to me. We two live together, and you were born."
"Son, protect your sister and love her." "I protect her. My sister is dear to me." "May the gods protect you two. May you two grow strong."
The father gave libated wine to the gods. "Gods, drink!" Then the mother gave the sons water, and the sons drank and became sated. The father said: "Sons, remember the gods."

The father had three sons. He said: "Who will guard the cattle?" "I shall guard them." "I shall plough the field." "I shall go, and I shall seek a wife." The father became glad. "May the gods protect my three sons."
Dear is the mother to the son, and dear is the son to the mother. The one who hears his own father's word is famous. The wife is the heart of the household.
"Son, go. May the gods lead you. Do not go astray. Remember your household, your father and your mother." "I shall go, and I shall come again." "May the day become bright for you."
Father Sky! Mother Earth! Hear us. Give this wife a good household. May she live, and may sons be born to her. "I give this woman to your son." "I shall love her."

title: The Bride Leaves Her Father's House

plan.english: Dawn became bright. Then the father yoked the two horses. The mother dressed the one who was marrying. The father led her out. The mother cried out: "Go, and may the gods protect you." "Do not be afraid." Then the two swift horses ran.

Father Sky, giver of good things! Hear our words. Give the two of them sons and cattle. May the wheel of the sun go before them. May they arrive at their household. May the fire burn. May their name be famous, and may they have great fame.

"We are guests. We have arrived at your household. We seek a wife for our son." "Sit and drink beer. If you give a bride price, we shall give the woman." "We shall give ten cattle and a hundred sheep." "Let there be a pledge."

title: The Father Listens to the Guests

plan.english: The father, listening to the words of the guests, led them into the household. The mother carried beer. The guests sat down. Then the father said: "What do you seek?" And then: "Give the bride price, and take the woman."

The two swift horses arrived. The husband's mother saw the daughter-in-law, and she became glad. "Daughter-in-law, enter the household. May our fire be dear to you. May the gods protect you." "I am your daughter-in-law, mother. I shall love this household."
"Wife, I marry you." "I marry you." "Let us two live together. May we two not go apart." "Let the gods hear our pledge. Let Mother Earth see it."

It was getting dark. The guests arrived. The cook was cooking, and the fire was burning. The father gave wine to the guests, and the guests drank and became joyful. The two brothers spoke a song of praise.

title: Prayer to Mother Earth for the Bride

plan.english: Mother Earth, you who nourish cattle and mortals! Give this wife many sons. May her sons grow up. May the cattle be many in her household. May she live.
"You are the mistress of this household, and I am the man of this household." "I have heard your words. You are dear to me." "You are dear to me."

title: The Husband's Brother Greets the Bride

plan.english: "I am a husband's brother to you. I shall be a brother to you." "I am glad, brother-in-law. Where is my husband?" "He is leading the horses. He will come." The husband's brother and the wife's brother sat down.
Swift are the horses, dear is the wife, good is the household. Dear to the husband is the wife; dear to the wife is the husband. May the gods give you a famous name. May no one deceive you.
"Son, you have married. Protect your wife and love her. Do not deceive her. The wife is the heart of the household." "I hear you, father, and I remember." "May the gods give you two many sons."
